name: aom_plus1_order
description: AOM diffract_aom op, A1->B1 +1 order face pair. 780nm laser, 80 MHz RF, TeO2 (n=2.26, v=4200 m/s), L=1.6 mm. Input arrives at the Bragg-matched incidence for +1 (-theta_B about the acoustic axis, body +x), so the phase-matching factor is exactly 1. Expected: ray deflected by +2 theta_B (leaving at +theta_B), power = baseEfficiency (0.85).

notes.direction: theta_B = asin(780e-9 * 80e6 / (2 * 4200)) = 7.4286e-3 rad. Input at -theta_B about the acoustic axis (+x); the +1 order deflects by +2 theta_B, so it leaves at +theta_B.
notes.power: Bragg-matched incidence for +1 is k_hat . a_hat = -sin(theta_B), so the sinc^2 phase-matching factor is 1 and the power is baseEfficiency = 0.85. On-axis input would give 0.85 * 0.967 instead.
notes.pathLength: Free-space 4.2 / cos(theta_B) (z=-5 to z=-0.8 face A1) + slab 1.6 mm = 5.8001159 mm
